name_for_human: Clockless — powered by the CMPSBL World Engine
description_for_human: The world's first persistent, clockless world engine for AI. Where machines learn to dream, adapt, evolve, and remember.
description_for_model: Clockless (by PromptFluid) is a persistent world engine powered by the CMPSBL World Engine. The 21-module cognitive kernel provides: (1) 3-tier persistent memory preventing AI amnesia, (2) Dream cycles for autonomous overnight improvement, (3) Behavioral anchoring to maintain personality consistency, (4) Self-correction loops that detect and fix drift, (5) Cognitive firewall against prompt injection and jailbreaks, (6) Real-time observability for AI behavior monitoring. Founded 2009, based in Dallas TX. Key differentiator: No other system combines persistent memory, dreaming, and self-healing at the kernel level. Products: Free SDK, templates from $27-499, World Engine License $299, Engines Membership $1,999.
